title: Example bucket init container: order via service_completed_successfully and keep it idempotent
answers: tracking server starts before bucket exists in docker compose example
mlflow artifact upload fails with NoSuchBucket in compose example
how to create S3 bucket in docker compose with aws cli
body:
Invariant: the client/tracking service must wait for the bucket-creation container to finish successfully, not merely start.
- In examples/mlflow_artifacts/docker-compose.yml the tracking service uses `depends_on: create-bucket: condition: service_completed_successfully`; a plain `depends_on` list only orders start, so the bucket may not exist yet.
- The create-bucket entrypoint (`/bin/sh -c` with `set -e`) runs `aws s3api head-bucket` first and only calls `create-bucket` if that fails, so re-running compose does not error on an existing bucket.
- Storage readiness is gated by the storage healthcheck (`condition: service_healthy`) before create-bucket runs.
Constraints: this replaces the earlier MinIO `mc` init; the `mc` image is no longer available on Docker Hub, so do not reintroduce it.
applies: Adding or reordering services in examples/mlflow_artifacts/docker-compose.yml that depend on bucket creation.
says: Artifact uploads fail with a missing bucket error in the local compose example.
The tracking server starts up before the storage bucket has been created.
Restarting the local container environment fails because the storage bucket already exists.
Ensure the storage bucket setup finishes completely before the tracking service launches.
Bucket initialization runs before the underlying local object storage service is fully healthy.
search: In examples/mlflow_artifacts/docker-compose.yml, the tracking service must gate startup on bucket creation completing via depends_on with condition service_completed_successfully. Storage readiness is gated first by the storage service healthcheck condition service_healthy before create-bucket executes. The create-bucket entrypoint checks aws s3api head-bucket before calling create-bucket to remain idempotent across restarts. This replaces the deprecated MinIO mc initialization container, which must not be reintroduced.
